The ground truth of this sector

Operators see Patient Priority Portal as one more decision surface with one difference: every recommendation carries its evidence, and every override is logged with a reason. The rollout order differs by industry; the operator experience does not — fewer surprises, faster answers, and a trail that makes the post-incident review short.
Bring a working session on Patient Priority Portal to a 45-minute briefing with the practice lead — your metric, our method, and an honest read on feasibility.
